themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in housing, social services, and employment. This theme has seen strong convergence as parties like Vox in Spain, Rassemblement National in France, and Sverigedemokraterna in Sweden align on rhetoric and legislative proposals to restrict non-citizen access to public resources.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia's government negotiations, insisting on policies favoring Spanish citizens in housing and social aid.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella proposes halving France's EU contribution to redirect funds to French citizens, emphasizing national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for stricter residency rules and prioritizes Swedish citizens in housing and social services.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes banning foreign nationals from social housing and imposing a 'migrant labour levy' on employers hiring foreign workers.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Madrid's transport card policy for not prioritizing registered residents, calling it a right-wing move.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for policies that prioritize Norwegian citizens in housing and social benefits, opposing migrant access to public resources.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The announcement of a preliminary U.S.-Iran peace deal has sparked intense cross-national reactions, with right-wing leaders in the U.S., Italy, France, Poland, and Spain either praising or criticizing the agreement. The deal's implications for regional stability, energy markets, and Western alliances have made it a defining transnational story.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration announces a 60-day ceasefire deal with Iran, aiming to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and limit Iran's nuclear capabilities.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni meets with Trump at the G7 summit to discuss the Iran deal, emphasizing Western unity and Italy's potential role in Hormuz Strait security.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella criticizes Trump's handling of the Iran deal, calling his approach 'erratic' and unreliable.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish officials discuss the Iran deal's implications for NATO and U.S.-Poland relations, with President Nawrocki meeting U.S. leaders to address regional security.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Praises the U.S.-Iran deal for potentially preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, aligning with broader right-wing support for Trump's foreign policy.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Italy, Argentina, the UK, Hungary, and Spain are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factional disputes. These tensions are reshaping political alliances and threatening party cohesion ahead of key elections.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini faces internal dissent within the Lega, with rising figures like Roberto Vannacci challenging his leadership and threatening party unity.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faces internal strife over Manuel Adorni's leadership, with allies like Patricia Bullrich distancing themselves amid corruption allegations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage's party faces defections and internal criticism over candidate vetting and party governance, with councillors quitting over 'toxic' infighting.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz re-elects Viktor Orbán as leader despite election losses, sparking debates over the party's future direction and internal reforms.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox faces internal tensions over coalition negotiations with PP in Andalusia, with some factions pushing for stricter policy demands.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces declining approval ratings as his government grapples with internal conflicts, corruption scandals, and legislative challenges. The ongoing turmoil surrounding his Chief of Staff, Manuel Adorni, has intensified scrutiny of Milei's leadership and economic policies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government faces mounting pressure over Manuel Adorni's alleged illicit enrichment, with opposition pushing for his removal and allies distancing themselves.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. media and political analysts closely follow Milei's struggles, drawing parallels to Trump's own challenges with internal divisions and legal scrutiny.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish right-wing media criticizes Milei's handling of internal crises, questioning his ability to implement promised economic reforms.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in the U.S., France, Italy, Spain, and Poland are reacting to escalating Middle East conflicts, particularly the U.S.-Iran tensions and the Israel-Hamas war. These reactions often emphasize national security, energy independence, and alignment with Western allies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration announces sanctions on Russian oil and plans to reinstate sanctions on Iran, emphasizing energy security and regional stability.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella criticizes Macron's handling of Middle East tensions, advocating for a stronger stance on national security and energy independence.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni discusses Italy's role in Hormuz Strait security and supports Western unity in addressing Middle East conflicts.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox aligns with U.S. policies on Iran, criticizing the Spanish government's stance on Middle East conflicts and advocating for stronger ties with Israel.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish officials discuss Middle East conflicts in the context of NATO security and U.S.-Poland relations, emphasizing alignment with Western allies.
